title: Preserve clipboard when running evaluate hotkeys (fix #3)
body:
## Summary Fixes [issue #3](https://github.com/endolith/monster-ahk/issues/3): the evaluate hotkeys cleared the clipboard before copying so prior clipboard content was lost. ## Changes - Save `ClipboardAll` before clearing (standalone assignment per AHK docs). - Restore after `SendInput` finishes and on early exit when line copy fails. - Free `ClipSaved` after restore.
  
## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Clipboard contents, including formatting, are now preserved when processing the current line. * Clipboard data is restored if copying the current line fails, preventing unintended clipboard changes.
